headline: Executive order on putting into effect a federal job category called Schedule Policy/Career for certain career government workers.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with carrying out a job category called Schedule Policy/Career within the excepted service. The excepted service is the part of the federal workforce hired and managed outside the standard civil service rules. Schedule Policy/Career has been described as covering career employees in jobs that shape or carry out policy, with fewer protections against being fired than most federal workers. No summary was provided, so the order's specific steps, such as which jobs are moved or what deadlines apply, are not known here.

who_it_affects.group: Career federal employees in policy-related jobs
who_it_affects.how: Their positions may be moved into the Schedule Policy/Career category, which can change their job protections and appeal rights.
They may have to identify which positions fall under this category and follow the order's steps to put it into effect.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 3, 2026; the specific effective dates for its provisions are not stated in the available information.
